c: You run the same image three times
q: How many images and how many containers?
why: A container is a running copy; many copies can come from one image.

c: uvicorn --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8041, then a call to the machine's network address
q: What happened (run for real, outside Docker)?
why: A server on 127.0.0.1 answers only from inside. In a container, use 0.0.0.0.
0.0.0.0 means every address of the machine, or of the container.

c: COPY . . comes before the install of the packages
q: What does a one-line edit of a .py file cost?
o: A full re-install: the cached layer is thrown away
why: Put what changes rarely first, so the slow layer stays cached.

c: An editable install in the first stage, then COPY of /opt/venv to the last stage
o: A path to the source folder that the last stage does not have
why: That is why the Dockerfile uses --no-editable.

c: The health command: a Python one-liner that exits 0 when /health answers 200
q: What does it exit with when the service is stopped?
why: The exit code is the whole contract.
